related_resources.reason: Original formulation of generalized metric spaces via enrichment in extended nonnegative reals.
Enriched category theory and concrete weighted limits and powers.
Author-hosted overview and private-use book access; mathematical reference, not replicated text.
Introductory treatment with examples, Yoneda, adjoints, limits; manuscript freely available.

historical_claims.anchor: A Lawvere metric space can be described as a category enriched over the extended nonnegative reals

description: Derives symmetric distance-profile embeddings and their asymmetric Lawvere-metric analogues using directed residuation. The enriched Yoneda lemma evaluates an arbitrary compatible presheaf by comparing it with a representable, recovering pairwise distance as a special case under the relevant enrichment hypotheses.
